# שָׁרְט

```
╔════════════════════════════════════════╗
║                                        ║
║     شَرْط ← → שָׁרְט                    ║
║                                        ║
║     condition / incision               ║
║     the cut that binds                 ║
║     the covenant marked in flesh       ║
║                                        ║
╠════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                        ║
║  ש ← ش    shared root                  ║
║  ר ← ر    across the mirror            ║
║  ט ← ط    semitic memory               ║
║                                        ║
║  to stipulate / to scratch             ║
║  a line drawn                          ║
║  a term agreed                         ║
║                                        ║
╠════════════════════════════════════════╣
║                                        ║
║  the condition of the wound            ║
║  is that it heals                      ║
║                                        ║
║  the condition of the word             ║
║  is that it cuts                       ║
║                                        ║
╚════════════════════════════════════════╝
```
